data.title: Hagrid speaking
data.statement:
Help J. K. Rowling in her writing. Indeed, Hagrid has a distinctive way of speaking.

<<Apply letter and word transformations>>
The final letter of each word is replaced by {{'}} if it is {{f}}, {{t}}, {{d}} or {{g}} (case-insensitive).
The first letter of each word is replaced by {{'}} if it is {{h}} or {{H}}.
The transformation should only take place if the word is longer than two characters.

The word {{you}} is replaced by the word {{yeh}}.
The word {{to}} is replaced by the word {{ter}}.
The word {{and}} is replaced by the word {{an'}}.
The word {{me}} is replaced by the word {{meh}}.

Word replacements are applied regardless of case. Letter transformations do not apply to words already modified by word replacements.

<<You have to be careful to modify only Hagrid's sentences.>>
A sentence is considered to be spoken by {{Hagrid}} if {{Hagrid}} is mentioned outside the quotation marks. 
For example : 
✅"You going to the forest?" Asked Hagrid. => Hagrid is the speaker in this sentence because he is mentioned outside the quotation marks.
❌"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully. => {{Hagrid}} is <<NOT>> the speaker in this sentence because he is <<NOT>> mentioned outside the quotation marks.

Only the standalone word {{Hagrid}} (case-sensitive) counts, for example: 
❌ McHagrid
❌ Hagride
❌ hagrid
✅ Hagrid

<<Punctuation must not be altered.>>
Words consist of consecutive English letters. Leading or trailing punctuation is <<not>> considered part of the word.
If a word contains an apostrophe ({{'}}) or a hyphen ({{-}}) like "can't", "right-handed" or "it's" it should not be modified.

<<Take care of the letter case.>>
The transformation must preserve the original case pattern. If the replacement is longer than the original word, any extra letters inherit the case of the last original letter.
For example: 
`YoU => YeH
going => goin'
TO => TER
mE => mEH
Hello => 'ello`

testCases.title: Simple sentences
testCases.testIn:
2
"You going to the forest?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh goin' ter the fores'?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.

testCases.title: Simple sentences - Validator
testCases.testIn:
2
"You going to the forest? Let me guide you." offered Hagrid.
"No change at all" Said Harry.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh goin' ter the fores'? Le' meh guide yeh." offered Hagrid.
"No change at all" Said Harry.

testCases.title: Does Hagrid speak?
testCases.testIn:
5
"This is mad!" Ron murmured, moving his free hand gingerly up and down his horse's neck.
"You'd better hope it stays invisible," said Harry darkly.
"We all ready, then?" added Harry.
They all nodded and he saw five pairs of knees tighten beneath their robes.
Hagrid went away from the Thestrals after their takeoff.
testCases.testOut:
"This is mad!" Ron murmured, moving his free hand gingerly up and down his horse's neck.
"You'd better hope it stays invisible," said Harry darkly.
"We all ready, then?" added Harry.
They all nodded and he saw five pairs of knees tighten beneath their robes.
Hagrid went away from the Thestrals after their takeoff.

testCases.title: Does Hagrid speak? - Validator
testCases.testIn:
3
"Don't rise," whispered Hermione.
"I mean," said Malfoy.
And Hagrid had to go to another place.
testCases.testOut:
"Don't rise," whispered Hermione.
"I mean," said Malfoy.
And Hagrid had to go to another place.

testCases.title: t,f, d and g replacement
testCases.testIn:
7
"Tell us about your summer and I'll tell you about mine, Hagrid." Said Harry.
Hagrid glared at him through his one open eye.
"Oh, all right" Hagrid said in a resigned voice.
He took another fortifying gulp of tea, then said.
"Well, we set off right after term ended..." Hagrid began.
"Madame Maxime went with you, then?" Hermione interjected.
"Yes and she took her dog with her" replied Hagrid.
testCases.testOut:
"Tell us about your summer and I'll tell you about mine, Hagrid." Said Harry.
Hagrid glared at him through his one open eye.
"Oh, all righ'" Hagrid said in a resigned voice.
He took another fortifying gulp of tea, then said.
"Well, we se' of' righ' after term ende'..." Hagrid began.
"Madame Maxime went with you, then?" Hermione interjected.
"Yes an' she took 'er do' with 'er" replied Hagrid.

testCases.title: t,f, d and g replacement - Validator
testCases.testIn:
4
"A soft wolf is a good dog." Hagrid said.
"But the cat went out to find food." Hagrid added.
"He left half of the meat behind." said Hagrid.
"Do not touch the letter." said Ron.
testCases.testOut:
"A sof' wol' is a goo' do'." Hagrid said.
"Bu' the ca' wen' ou' ter fin' foo'." Hagrid added.
"He lef' 'al' of the mea' behin'." said Hagrid.
"Do not touch the letter." said Ron.

testCases.testIn:
1
"You need to come down to the hut with Ron and me!" said Hagrid.
testCases.testOut: "Yeh nee' ter come down ter the 'u' with Ron an' meh!" said Hagrid.

testCases.testIn:
1
"I baked it myself for you and me to share! Come with me!" Hagrid said proudly.
testCases.testOut: "I bake' it mysel' for yeh an' meh ter share! Come with meh!" Hagrid said proudly.

testCases.title: Do yeh forge' the case?
testCases.testIn:
2
"HEY RON! How are you?" Hagrid shouted before lowering his voice.
"I am FINE, thank you."
testCases.testOut:
"'EY RON! 'ow are yeh?" Hagrid shouted before lowering his voice.
"I am FINE, thank you."

testCases.title: Do yeh forge' the case? - Validator
testCases.testIn:
2
"You told me To stop And hide. How did you do?" Hagrid whispered.
"How are you doing?"
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh tol' meh Ter stop An' 'ide. 'ow di' yeh do?" Hagrid whispered.

testCases.title: Compound Words
testCases.testIn:
1
"You need to listen to me! That three-headed dog and that blast-ended skrewt are dangerous!" warned Hagrid.
testCases.testOut: "Yeh nee' ter listen ter meh! Tha' three-headed do' an' tha' blast-ended skrew' are dangerous!" warned Hagrid.

testCases.title: Edge cases - Validator
testCases.testIn:
8
"Here is my to-do list, don't forget the forget-me-not, and you'll see!" said Hagrid.

testCases.title: Very long talk
testCases.testIn:
11
"You and me have to go to the dark forest to hunt the half hound and find the hot food!" Hagrid roared.
"I do not want to go to the forest with you and him!" Ron yelled.
"Wait! What? How are you doing today? It is hot, hard, and terrifying to find food in the forest..." said Hagrid.
"You, you, you, and me, me, me, to, to, to, the, the, the forest, forest, forest!" Hagrid mumbled.
"Harry, you have to find out what happened to the dog, the half hound that we saw in the forest!" Hermione whispered.
"You have to help me, Harry! The forest is dark and full of bad things, huge dogs and hot fire!" Hagrid panicked.
"And, if you want, we can go to the pub to get a hot tea." Hagrid proposed.
"But the huge half hound had a hard tooth that could cut a tough log." Hagrid explained.
"Me and you, Harry, we are a good team to find the bad dog." Hagrid smiled.
"Watch yourself!" shouted Hagrid.
"What you've done is meaningless?!" cried Hagrid.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh an' meh 'ave ter go ter the dark fores' ter 'un' the 'al' 'oun' an' fin' the 'o' foo'!" Hagrid roared.
"I do not want to go to the forest with you and him!" Ron yelled.
"Wai'! Wha'? 'ow are yeh doin' today? It is 'o', 'ar', an' terrifyin' ter fin' foo' in the fores'..." said Hagrid.
"Yeh, yeh, yeh, an' meh, meh, meh, ter, ter, ter, the, the, the fores', fores', fores'!" Hagrid mumbled.
"Harry, you have to find out what happened to the dog, the half hound that we saw in the forest!" Hermione whispered.
"Yeh 'ave ter 'elp meh, 'arry! The fores' is dark an' full of ba' things, 'uge dogs an' 'o' fire!" Hagrid panicked.
"An', if yeh wan', we can go ter the pub ter ge' a 'o' tea." Hagrid proposed.
"Bu' the 'uge 'al' 'oun' 'a' a 'ar' tooth tha' coul' cu' a tough lo'." Hagrid explained.
"Meh an' yeh, 'arry, we are a goo' team ter fin' the ba' do'." Hagrid smiled.
"Watch yoursel'!" shouted Hagrid.
"Wha' you've done is meaningless?!" cried Hagrid.

testCases.title: Very long talk - Validator
testCases.testIn:
10
"Harry, hurry and hand me the huge hot dog!" Hagrid bellowed.
"You mean the youth band went to the meadow today?" Hagrid asked.
"Hagrid, did you find the food?" asked Hermione.
"This is it! And you and me... to do it? Good god!" Hagrid cried.
"If you want to go and find the half blood hound, you have to help me, Harry, to get the meat and the food to the dark forest!" Hagrid said.
"You? Me? To the forest? And why not him?" Hagrid murmured.
"I told Hagrid that he had to stay behind." Ron said.
"And and and to to to you you you me me me!" Hagrid shouted.
"Half of the giant squids went mad and hid in the mud." Hagrid noted.
"He had a hard hat, and he hit the troll hard on the head." Hagrid laughed.
testCases.testOut:
"'arry, 'urry an' 'an' meh the 'uge 'o' do'!" Hagrid bellowed.
"Yeh mean the youth ban' wen' ter the meadow today?" Hagrid asked.
"Hagrid, did you find the food?" asked Hermione.
"This is it! An' yeh an' meh... ter do it? Goo' go'!" Hagrid cried.
"If yeh wan' ter go an' fin' the 'al' bloo' 'oun', yeh 'ave ter 'elp meh, 'arry, ter ge' the mea' an' the foo' ter the dark fores'!" Hagrid said.
"Yeh? Meh? Ter the fores'? An' why no' 'im?" Hagrid murmured.
"I told Hagrid that he had to stay behind." Ron said.
"An' an' an' ter ter ter yeh yeh yeh meh meh meh!" Hagrid shouted.
"'al' of the gian' squids wen' ma' an' 'i' in the mu'." Hagrid noted.
"He 'a' a 'ar' 'a', an' he 'i' the troll 'ar' on the 'ea'." Hagrid laughed.
